Could the Zigbee smart wall switch control the IKEA TRÅDFRI 30 W LED Driver (in order to switch under-cabinet LEDs ON/OFF), as well as turn on/off ceiling lights - Preferably without the use of a HUB, but open to the idea.


The desired end result is that the wall switch simultaneously turns the ceiling lights AND under-cabinet LEDs ON/OFF at the same time.

Gemini said

Yes, you can configure a Zigbee smart wall switch to simultaneously turn on and off both your wired ceiling lights and your wireless IKEA TRÅDFRI LED driver with a single press.

How the Dual Control Works

  1. Wired Ceiling Lights (Physical Control): Your ceiling lights wire directly to the smart switch's physical relay (LOAD wire). Pressing the switch toggles power to the ceiling lights instantly.

  2. TRÅDFRI LED Driver (Wireless Control): Your TRÅDFRI 30 W driver stays constantly powered on its own circuit/plug. When you press the switch, the switch sends an over-the-air Zigbee ON/OFF signal to the driver at the same time it toggles its physical relay.

Controlling It Without a Hub: Zigbee Direct Binding

You can achieve direct switch-to-driver control without needing a hub for daily operation through a technology called Zigbee Direct Binding:

  • Near-Zero Latency: The wall switch communicates straight to the TRÅDFRI driver over the local Zigbee mesh network, toggling both light sources instantly.

  • No Internet or Network Needed: Even if your local home network or internet goes down, the wall switch will still operate both the ceiling lights and under-cabinet LEDs.

Important Note on Initial Setup

While daily operation does not require a hub, setting up the initial binding link between the switch and driver requires a temporary Zigbee coordinator/hub (such as Home Assistant, Hubitat, or SmartThings). Once you bind the switch to the driver's Zigbee address, the hub can be disconnected, and the two devices will continue talking directly.

Best Hardware Choice

The Inovelli Blue Series Zigbee Smart Dimmer and On/Off Switch is ideal for this setup. Unlike standard smart switches, Endpoint 1 on the Inovelli Blue can operate its internal relay (for your ceiling lights) while simultaneously broadcasting binding commands to external Zigbee devices like your TRÅDFRI driver.
